pulse.text: **Astra's mid-September leg jumped eight points this sweep** — Polymarket now prices an OpenAI Astra release by Sep 15 at **64%, up from 56%** this morning, with the Aug 31 leg firming to 23% and Oct 31 at 86%, even as Sep 30 eased a hair to 76%. GPT-6 moved the other way: Polymarket's Sep 30 leg slid to **38% from 41%**, and Manifold prices only 26% before October against 87% before 2027. Anthropic's year-end grip loosened slightly again, to **68% from 69%** on Polymarket, though August is effectively locked at 97.4% and September sits at 88%. **Nothing has shipped since Aug 14** — GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.8-27B remain the newest models and Claude Opus 5 still holds the leaderboard at AA-Index **63**, ahead of Fable 5 at 62 and Grok 4.6 at 61. On the money side, Nvidia closed near $225 for a second straight session as the $105B Ohio guarantee and a **$500B** financing push with six asset managers reframed how risky the buildout looks, with fiscal-Q2 earnings due Aug 26. Worth watching next: whether Astra's Sep-15 move holds or retraces, and whether the next Gemini Pro's Sep 15 leg (43%) keeps climbing toward its 52% Sep 30 mark.
